summary.npu_status: PRESENT BUT UNUSABLE — Windows recognizes 'NVIDIA NPU' (ACPI\NVDA200A\0, MCDM driver, bundled under the main GPU driver package) but there is no installed NPU SDK and no ARM64-Windows wheel for any ONNX Runtime execution provider (DirectML/QNN) that could reach it. ggml (whisper.cpp/llama.cpp) has no NPU backend concept at all. Revisit when NVIDIA publishes an NPU SDK for this platform.
key_engineering_notes_for_p1_plus: 所有 ggml-based CPU backend 編譯必須用 clang-cl，不能用純 MSVC (cl.exe)
CUDA (.cu) 編譯的 host compiler 必須用 cl.exe，不能用 clang-cl（跟上一條剛好相反，需混合 toolchain）— 這個公式對 whisper.cpp 跟 llama.cpp 都適用
GGML_OPENMP 目前必須關閉（缺 release 版 libomp140.aarch64.dll），如需開啟，需另外安裝正確的 VC redist ARM64 元件
faster-whisper / ctranslate2 路線在此機器上完全不可行，正式方案排除，全部走 whisper.cpp
onnxruntime-directml / onnxruntime-gpu 在 ARM64 都無 wheel，VAD/喚醒詞這類小模型建議留在 CPU 運算，不值得為了榨GPU/NPU去自編onnxruntime原始碼
NPU（ACPI\NVDA200A\0）目前沒有可用的軟體介面，暫列觀察項目，非P0阻塞項
